articles.title: Remote appoints new CBO and expands leadership team to meet surging enterprise demand globally
articles.mainIdea: Remote appoints new CBO and expands leadership team to meet surging enterprise demand globally
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Remote appoints new CBO and expands leadership team to meet surging enterprise demand globally. Remote, the leading global employment operating system, today announced five senior leadership appointments as more companies rely on the platform to hire, manage, and pay teams worldwide. Remote now supports tens of thousands of customers and has processed billions of dollars in payroll.
